groups.activity: pledge Cephalon Suda, earn standing from mission affinity and Syndicate Medallions
groups.meta: 340,000 standing total to Genius plus the gun
groups.mode: leave around round 8 for one clean daily cap

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 2 at Rank 4 Wise, 3 at Rank 5 Genius

conditions: Daily standing cap is 16,000 plus 500 per Mastery Rank, shared across every faction syndicate.
Pledging New Loka drops Suda standing by 100% and Red Veil by 50% on every gain; climb out of the negative first if you're ranked with either.
Rank up as soon as you can afford it. Standing earned past a rank's maximum is wasted.
bonuses: Pledging Arbiters of Hexis feeds Suda passively at +50% without hurting it.
Suda's three daily Syndicate Alerts each hold 8 medallions (roughly 10,000 standing) and, like the medallions themselves, ignore the daily cap entirely — worth more than the mission reward.

disclosures.title: why 340,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to Genius. The 100,000-standing weapon purchase then has to be farmed fresh — the bar resets to 0 at each rank-up, it doesn't bank extra for the gun.

conditions: The free item you pick at Rank 5 can never be a Syndicate weapon; the Gammacor is always a separate 100,000-standing purchase.
Mastery Rank 7 is required both to buy it and to receive it in a trade.
